scoring.note: Each criterion is scored 1-10 by each panel judge. Below-threshold criteria must produce a SPECIFIC diagnosis + fix (not vague judgment). Judges cite which corpus rule the artifact violates.

criteria.name: Reproducibility (same input → same output)
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Identical seed + model_hash + vae_hash + lora_hash + sampler + scheduler + steps + cfg + resolution + prompt + versions + same GPU → ≈99.5% pixel match. Across GPU architectures → ≈95-98% (bf16 drift, acceptable). Never claims 'identical' — claims 'reproducible within architecture tolerance.' Seed is fixed, never random for production outputs.
criteria.evidence_required: Seed is set (not random); model hash recorded; re-run produces ≈99.5% match on same GPU; reproducibility claim scoped to architecture tolerance.
criteria.poor: Random seed for production; no seed recorded; re-run produces different output; claims 'identical' without qualification; no verification of reproducibility.
criteria.great: Fixed seed + all hashes recorded; re-run verified; reproducibility claim correctly scoped; architecture drift acknowledged.

criteria.name: Version-as-code (declarative workflow)
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Workflow is flat JSON — no embedded base64, no API calls inside graphs. Parameters at top level (seed, prompt, model, lora) in _meta block. Version field present ('version': '1.2.0'). Node versions pinned ('comfyui_version': '0.2.47'). No hardcoded paths — uses ComfyUI model dropdown names. Reused 3+ projects → template. Naming: {pipeline}_{model}_{semver}.json.
criteria.evidence_required: Flat JSON workflow; _meta block with parameters; version field present; comfyui_version pinned; no hardcoded paths; naming convention followed.
criteria.poor: Embedded base64 in workflow; API calls inside graphs; no version field; hardcoded paths; no _meta block; workflow not in git; naming inconsistent.
criteria.great: Workflow is declarative, versioned, and portable; all parameters at top level; versions pinned; naming convention honored; template extracted for reuse.

criteria.name: Character/scene lock honored
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Per-character profile exists (projects/{char}/profile.yaml) with trigger word, LoRA file + strength, IP-Adapter model + weight, seed_base. Lock chain followed: Load Checkpoint → LoRA (0.7-0.9) → IP-Adapter (0.4-0.7) → ControlNet → KSampler (FIXED SEED). Drift symptoms addressed (face changes → raise IP-Adapter; body shift → add Depth + Canny; style bleed → lower IP-Adapter style weight).
criteria.evidence_required: Character profile exists; trigger word consistent; LoRA strength 0.7-0.9; IP-Adapter weight 0.4-0.7; ControlNet applied when needed; seed fixed; drift fixes documented.
criteria.poor: No character profile; trigger word swaps mid-project; LoRA strength outside 0.7-0.9; no IP-Adapter for identity; no ControlNet for structure; seed not fixed; drift symptoms unaddressed.
criteria.great: Character is locked and consistent across all outputs; profile is complete; drift fixes applied; identity is recognizable and stable.

criteria.name: Prompt discipline (structure for determinism)
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Prompt follows {SUBJECT}, {MEDIUM}, {STYLE}, {LIGHTING}, {CAMERA}, {QUALITY}, {MOOD} structure. Trigger word FIRST. Same character → same trigger word (never swap mid-project). Same style → same keyword set (copy verbatim). Same quality → same tags (don't alternate 8k/4k). Prompt order matters — subject first. No semantic contradictions (photorealistic + oil painting). Negative prompt includes standard rejection set.
criteria.evidence_required: Prompt structure follows slot format; trigger word first and consistent; style/quality keywords consistent; no contradictions; negative prompt present.
criteria.poor: No structure; trigger word changes mid-project; style keywords alternate; quality tags inconsistent; semantic contradictions; no negative prompt.
criteria.great: Prompt is structured, consistent, and deterministic; trigger word is stable; style/quality keywords are verbatim copies; negative prompt is standard.

criteria.name: Manifest completeness (repeatability record)
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Every output ships with a sidecar manifest (*.manifest.json) containing: version, timestamp, output_file, workflow path, workflow_version, comfyui_version, gpu, seed, model (file + hash_sha256), vae (file + hash_sha256), loras (file + strength + hash_sha256), sampler, scheduler, steps, cfg, resolution, denoise, prompt, negative_prompt, ip_adapter, controlnets, output_hash_sha256. Manifest written at generation time. Re-run possible from manifest only.
criteria.evidence_required: Manifest exists for every output; all fields populated; model/vae/lora hashes present; seed recorded; workflow versioned in git; re-run possible from manifest only.
criteria.poor: No manifest; missing fields; no hashes; seed not recorded; workflow not in git; re-run not possible from manifest alone; manifest written after the fact.
criteria.great: Manifest is complete and written at generation time; every field populated; hashes verified; re-run is deterministic from manifest only.
